gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Chunky pixels, then soft sans. Press Start 2P keeps its strokes almost uniform, while Noto Sans Osmanya swings wide, easy curves and lowercase that towers over its capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-h: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong stands tall and tidy. Press Start 2P adds retro bounce up top, its curves thinning only slightly at the ends, and a slightly larger body size would suit that high x-height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-palmyren: Arcade-cabinet energy meets restraint, with Press Start 2P spaced wide and its stress only mildly marked above. Noto Sans Palmyrene stops its curves short.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads open and breezy, its capitals barely rising over the lowercase. Press Start 2P is the one that grabs the eye with thick strokes, while Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau simply keeps the lines moving.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa opens its letters so you can see straight through them, with capitals rising only gently. And Press Start 2P, with its faint stroke variation, gives that plain sans a playful retro hat.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-phoenici: Press Start 2P brings pixel-era fun with strokes that shift just enough to notice. Noto Sans Phoenician follows with generous lowercase height and wide-open s curves, so paragraphs of it feel unhurried and easy on the eye.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-psalter-: Press Start 2P wears its retro fun with a faint but real thick-thin shift in the strokes. But Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi settles in beneath it with gaping e shapes and barely rising capitals, a sans-serif foil that lets the heading play.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Press Start 2P stays playful and retro, its weight shifting gently from stem to end. And Noto Sans Rejang sits beneath with lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, a sans that keeps the page clear and open.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-runic: Press Start 2P looks like a game screen, mellow in its weight shifts. Noto Sans Runic matches that with a big x-height and curves that never close, and the lowercase generosity is this pair's real strength.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-samarita: Noto Sans Samaritan reads hefty and friendly, with plenty of daylight inside every curve. Under Press Start 2P's pixel-bright heading, a long page of it moves along smoothly, its solid lowercase carrying the eye line after line.
